title: fix(platform-objects)!: sys_oauth_application.type declares only web and native, the two application types its writer produces
body:
Fixes #25053
Clause-②: no (narrowing): the declared option set that `/meta` serves and the write path judges loses `useragentbased` and `public`, which no writer produces. It owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue.

`sys_oauth_application.type` now declares exactly the two application types its one writer produces, `web` and `native`, under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove. No stored row is rewritten, and every door that answers today for a row holding any type answers the same after the change (M1). One BREAKING `minor` changeset for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

## What changes

`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-oauth-application.object.ts`, the stored `type` column's declaration and two comments:

| | Before (`a39389eb5`) | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| declaration | `Field.select(['web', 'native', 'user-agent-based', 'public'], ...)` | `Field.select(['web', 'native'], ...)` |
| served options (`GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_oauth_application`) | `web`, `native`, `useragentbased` (label `user-agent-based`), `public` | `web`, `native` |
| `required` / `defaultValue` | `false` / `web` | unchanged |

- The values are spelled so that the string shorthand's hyphen stripping (#25013, still open, not touched here) cannot change them: neither has a hyphen, and the new pin asserts each option's value equals its label.
- The register form's own `type` param already offers only `web` and `native` (half 2b of #24773). It is not changed.
- The action's code comment said the stored column "is not narrowed". It now says the column declares the same two values. The field gains a comment stating the writer readings and the legacy-row behaviour below.
- The four translation bundles drop the two option keys, regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects` (translated values for `web` and `native` kept by merge mode).

## Measured first

### M1: every door, before and after, over rows holding each type

Real composition: `bootShowcase` (the dogfood harness, `OS_OIDC_PROVIDER_ENABLED=true`), signed in as the seeded platform admin. Six rows were seeded at driver level, owned by the admin, holding `type` `web`, `native`, `user-agent-based`, `null`, `useragentbased` and `public`. The probe was a throwaway file in `packages/qa/dogfood/test`, run once before the change (closure built at `a39389eb5`) and once after (`platform-objects` rebuilt), and is not in this PR.

| Door | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_oauth_application`, the `type` options | 4 options (above) | `web`, `native` |
| `GET /api/v1/data/sys_oauth_application` (list) | 200; all six rows listed, each with its stored type | identical |
| `GET /api/v1/data/sys_oauth_application/:id` | 200 for all six, stored type returned | identical |
| `GET /api/v1/auth/oauth2/get-client` | 200 for all six; `application_type` is the stored value (absent for `null`) | identical |
| `POST /api/v1/data/sys_oauth_application`, `PATCH .../:id`, `POST .../import` | 405 for every value | identical |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth2/update-client` (rename only) | `web`, `native`, `null`: 200. `user-agent-based`, `useragentbased`, `public`: 400 `invalid_client_metadata` from the provider, row unchanged | identical |
| `PATCH /api/v1/auth/admin/oauth2/update-client` | 404 for all (not mounted at this boot) | identical |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/oauth2/toggle-disabled` | 200 for all six; `disabled` set, type unchanged | identical |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth2/client/rotate-secret` | 200 for all six; secret changed, type unchanged | identical |
| engine insert / update SENDING `type` (system context, as plugin-auth's adapter writes) | `web`, `native`, `null`, `useragentbased`, `public` accepted; `user-agent-based` refused `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `invalid_option` | `web`, `native`, `null` accepted; `user-agent-based`, `useragentbased`, `public` refused `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `invalid_option` |
| engine update of another field on each row | accepted for all six, type unchanged | identical |

So the only movements are the served option list and the engine's verdict on a write that sends `useragentbased` or `public`. No door sends either value: the provider sends `web`, `native` or no type, and the generic data API answers 405. H4 holds, so this is `done`, not `needs_decision`: no door that works today with such a row refuses it after, and no mapping of `user-agent-based` is needed.

### M2: the writers (H1)

Re-measured on `origin/main` from source and the installed dist:
- `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.3 (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json`, exact pin). Every creation path goes through `persistOAuthClientRegistration` and `checkOAuthClient`, which refuses any `application_type` other than `web` / `native` (`dist/authorize-9whjxVLJ.mjs:1770`). The default is `web`, or `null` for a client-metadata-document registration that names none (`:1956`). Both update paths declare `application_type` as `z.enum(["web", "native"])` (`:2885`, `:2923`) and re-run `checkOAuthClient` over the stored client merged with the update (`:2420`), which is the 400 in M1.
- The mapping: `applicationType: 'type'` in `auth-schema-config.ts:489`. The generic data API: `apiMethods: ['get', 'list']` (`sys-oauth-application.object.ts:657`), measured as 405 above.
- The client-metadata-document seam (`registerClientMetadataDocument`) is exported only from `@better-auth/oauth-provider/internal`, and nothing in `plugin-auth/src` imports it (`grep -r` for the function and the subpath: 0 hits), so the `null` writer is not reachable in this composition (see Acceptance notes).

### M3: `null` and `required` (H3)

`type` is `required: false` today (M1's `/meta` reading) and stays so. A `null` row reads and lists (M1), and an engine update that sends `null` is accepted and stores `null`, before and after. The new pin asserts `required: false`.

### M4: the console

Read from objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `cf153eb2e`: `SelectCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) renders a value that matches no option as a humanized label of the raw value, and an empty value as the empty placeholder. A `user-agent-based` row matched no option before (the option value was `useragentbased`) and matches none after, so it renders the same. Only a `useragentbased` or `public` row, which no writer produces, now renders humanized instead of with an option label. The register form carries its own options (unchanged), and the record has no edit door (405).

## Tests

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-oauth-application.type-options.test.ts` (new, 5 tests): the options are exactly `web` and `native`, each value equal to its label; `required: false` and default `web`; the register form offers the same values; all four bundles translate exactly those two; the `public` column is kept.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/oauth-register-form-types.test.ts`: half 2b's describe that pinned the four options is removed (its header now points at the new file).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-application-type-column.test.ts` (new, 39 tests), on a real ObjectQL engine over SQLite with the auth manifest's objects and real better-auth with the OIDC provider:
  - a row holding each of `web`, `native`, `null`, `user-agent-based`, `useragentbased`, `public` reads and lists with its stored value, and the provider's `getOAuthClient` returns it;
  - the bridge's `disabled` write and the provider's `rotateClientSecret` are accepted on every such row, the type unchanged;
  - the provider's `updateOAuthClient` refuses a rename that leaves an undeclared type in place (`invalid_client_metadata`, row unchanged), and accepts one that also sets `application_type: 'native'`, storing `native` (the remedy the changeset names);
  - an insert or update SENDING `user-agent-based`, `useragentbased` or `public` is refused: `resolveThrownHttpError` gives `status` 400 and `code` `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `details.fields` holds one `invalid_option` on `type`, nothing is written; `web`, `native` and `null` are accepted.
  - These pins live in `plugin-auth` rather than beside the `platform-objects` identity tests because `platform-objects` cannot import `@objectstack/objectql`, which depends on it (`plugin.test.ts` records the cycle). The new file imports `platform-objects` through its `dist`, a pair already in `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS`.

Results (os-verify-lock `VERDICT command-exit 0` on each):
- `platform-objects` at `2d158a9dd`: `Test Files 84 passed (84)`, `Tests 1242 passed (1242)`. Typecheck exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`, 2 pinned signatures held; the new test is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly`: 1 hit).
- `plugin-auth` at `2d158a9dd`: the full suite `Test Files 178 passed (178)`, `Tests 3415 passed | 10 skipped (3425)`. Typecheck exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`, 23 pinned signatures held; the new file is in the program (1 hit).
- After merging `origin/main` `4feccc268` (head `17458f50d`): the ablation's control legs below re-ran both new files green (5/5, 39/39), and `check:i18n` stayed in sync.

## Ablation (one-shot, no permanent file)

One leg restored the retired options: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold` replaced the declaration with `Field.select(['web', 'native', 'user-agent-based', 'public'], ...)` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `2f185ac16441` to `1af41cbfc3ae`), inside a runner with its own EXIT/INT/TERM restore trap. Predicted before the run: leg 1 turns 2 of 5 red, leg 2 turns 4 of 39 red.
- **Leg 1, source:** `sys-oauth-application.type-options.test.ts`: `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`. Red: the option set (`expected [ 'web', 'native', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'web', 'native' ]`) and the form parity. Green as predicted: the default, the bundles (not regenerated), the `public` column.
- **Leg 2, dist:** `platform-objects` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in 4 built files (its dist reading passed; its tree reading refused because the dist spelling uses double quotes and no `--source-marker` was passed, exit 3). Then `oauth-application-type-column.test.ts`: `Tests 4 failed | 35 passed (39)`. Red: insert and update with `useragentbased` and with `public`, accepted again. `user-agent-based` stayed refused, because the shorthand still strips it.
- **Restore:** blob `2f185ac16441` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt; the preflight `--absent` found the marker in none of 66 built files and the tree clean; both files green (5/5, 39/39); `git status --porcelain` empty.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the final head `17458f50d` derived 69 commands (9 paths, 467 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold). Each ran after a whole-workspace build (`turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs`, 76 tasks), as `eval cmd > log 2>&1; status=$?`, recorded byte for byte with `:: exit N`.
- All 69 exit 0. `--ran`: `Run reconciliation — 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.`
- Verdicts among them: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: `1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition`, read as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check-changeset-no-major`: no `major` bump. `check-empty-changeset`: no merge-base changeset modified or deleted at `17458f50d`; at `a72b7acf8` it exits 1 by design, naming only `.changeset/24773-oauth-form-types.md` (the deliberate correction above). `check:i18n`: all 10 packages in sync. Also green: `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:type-check-debt`.
- The five roster families whose roster sits under one of these paths, run besides: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:auth-mount-ledger`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, all exit 0.
- Not run locally: `test:repo` (CI's `Test Core`); the type-check lanes and CI-only jobs the derivation lists outside the 69; `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` (no `packages/spec` build input or frame file touched); `check-platform-checklist --changed-from` (no exported symbol renamed or removed).

Patch round 1 (`a72b7acf8`, two `.changeset` lines only): the same 69 commands re-derived and re-run after a workspace build; 68 exit 0 and `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exits 1 as above. `--ran`: `Run reconciliation — 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.`

## Dogfood

The `Clause-②` line carries `(narrowing)`, so the full battery ran once on the final head `17458f50d`, as CI spells it: the closure built (`turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs`, 76 tasks, a superset of `@objectstack/dogfood^...`), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, with no `OS_TEST_SHARD` and no path.
- `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 1130s (18m50s)` (shared-box seconds).
- `Test Files 286 passed | 3 skipped (289)`, `Tests 2387 passed | 18 skipped (2405)`. No failure.
- The derivation notes that `Dogfood Regression Gate` does not run on a PR or in the merge queue, so this is the only pre-merge reading of it.

The head merges `origin/main` `4feccc268`. `main` has since moved to `1862d8d13` (two commits in `packages/spec`, `driver-turso` and `service-datasource`), none of which touches a path of this diff, so the head was not re-merged before opening.

Patch round 1 re-ran the full battery on `a72b7acf8`: `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 1284s (21m24s)`, `Test Files 286 passed | 3 skipped (289)`, `Tests 2387 passed | 18 skipped (2405)`. The head still merges `origin/main` `4feccc268`; `main` is at `8f59304dd`, with no path of this diff moved.

## Acceptance notes

- **A pending changeset sentence this change made false, corrected here (patch round 1, `a72b7acf8`).** `.changeset/24773-oauth-form-types.md` (half 2b, still pending) said: "The stored `sys_oauth_application.type` column still lists all four values, so a row written under an earlier provider line keeps its value. The `public` column is unchanged." That bullet now reads: "A row written under an earlier provider line keeps its stored type, and the `public` column is unchanged; the stored column's options narrow to Web and Native in this release's `sys_oauth_application.type` entry." No other line of that note changed. This PR's own changeset now says "The register-form entry in this release refers to this entry for the stored column's options." where it said it superseded that sentence. `Check Changeset` is red by design: `check-empty-changeset`'s DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, naming only `.changeset/24773-oauth-form-types.md`, for the seat's same-head contract review.
- **A `null` the provider sends on insert is stored as `web`.** Measured in M1: an engine insert with `type: null` stores `web` (the declared default fills the blank), while an update that sends `null` stores `null`. The provider sends `null` only for a client-metadata-document registration, whose seam this composition does not wire. Unchanged by this PR; noted, not filed.
- **Legacy rows and the provider's update path.** A row holding `user-agent-based` (or any type other than `web` / `native`) is refused by the provider's own update path unless the update also sets `application_type`, before and after this change (M1, and pinned). No deployment's data is in reach to count such rows.
- #25013 (the shorthand that strips hyphens) remains open; this PR only spells its values so the shorthand cannot change them.
